_about: Curated title variants that are verified to be ONE film. Read by scripts/film_identity.py. Each group lists every spelling seen on an official or aggregator programme; matching is direction-agnostic (any title in a group resolves to the group's film). 'film' pins the catalogue id; 'venues' (optional) limits the group to those venues. Add a group only after checking the venue's own film page (runtime, year, poster). Never add look-alikes that are different films ('Аватар' vs 'Аватар: Огън и пепел', 'Падане' vs 'Падане 2'). A group may also carry 'year', 'director' and 'original' — as the venue's own film page prints them (the original title only where that year and director identify the film): fetch_tmdb.py searches TMDB with them and accepts only a film of that year (±1), so a yearless festival title ("It’s Alive! … Нещото") is matched to the classic, never to its remake.
